title: Chapter 176
text:
"The beasts are starting to kill each other."

Both of them were overjoyed and decided to wait and see.

The battle between the beasts lasted for more than half an hour, leaving behind corpses all over the ground. The white lion was the final winner. The blood of the other beasts stained its white fur. It stood majestically in front of the crack and roared at the remaining beasts. Its roar was as loud as thunder, indicating that it was its prey. The beasts all turned around and retreated, leaving the prey to the king.

Although the beasts had left, the most powerful white lion was still guarding outside. The crack was dug open, and the hole gradually expanded. Soon, the two would not be able to hide anymore.

Their hearts sank to the bottom of the valley.

Ned pursed his lips and said with a serious expression, "You're too heavily injured. You go and be the bait. I might be able to survive."

Yang Dian looked down at his heavily injured body and said helplessly, "I can't escape. It's better to have one dead than all dead. If you can survive, remember to take care of my family."

"Don't worry. I'll raise your children and take care of your wife."

They looked at each other and fell silent for a while. Suddenly, they smiled bitterly.

"Stop talking nonsense. If we die, we die together."

Yang Dian struggled to stand up and said with a hoarse voice, "Let's fight."

Ned nodded. His hands lit up with white light, ready to attack.

Just as the two of them were about to rush out of the crack and fight to the death, a blue light suddenly swept across the night sky and hit the white lion's left eye. The eyeball exploded with a bang, and blood splattered everywhere. Only then did the two of them hear the faint sound of a gunshot.

The white lion roared and rushed toward the direction of the gunshot like a madman.

The two of them were shocked, then overjoyed.

"Someone's helping!"

Five hundred meters away, Han Xiao was lying on the ground, holding the Ghost sniper rifle. The circuit on the rifle was glowing with blue light.

Through the scope, he saw the white lion's left eye drenched in blood and rushing toward him.

This shot was enhanced by [Flaming Will]. His luck was not bad, and the damage was 2.2 times. Together with [Overload], critical hit, and sneak attack critical hit, the actual damage was 1,800 points! It was the highest damage he had ever dealt!

However, the White Lion was still alive and kicking. Han Xiao looked at the interface. This White Lion was indeed a Beast King. Its real name was Mutant White Lion King. It was a Level 56 wild beast and had many Molding Abilities of wild beasts. Its HP was over 18,000, and this shot had only shaved off one-ninth of its HP. It also had the debuff of Vision Loss.

Mutant White Lion King

Level: 56

HP: 15724/18700

Status: -50% Vision, Moderate Bleeding

Stats: 135 STR, 126 DEX, 240 END, 30 INT, 22 MYS, 31 CHA, 24 LUK

Its attributes were very high, and it also had many talents and skills. Among them, there was a very dangerous Molding Skill called [Fury]. As its HP decreased, it would greatly increase its movement speed, attack speed, and attack power.

This was a Boss that should have been dealt with by a small team. Han Xiao was here alone. With the capabilities of the mecha, he could reduce the risk.

Han Xiao got up and slid backward, firing continuously with his sniper rifle. Although he was wearing Viper, he would not directly engage in close combat. Coordination was the way to go. The combination of sniping and the mecha gave him an advantage in both close and ranged combat. The mecha's scanning module showed the surrounding terrain. Han Xiao did not need to look back. The mecha automatically retreated along the best route, so he could focus on dealing damage.

After kiting for a while, Han Xiao emptied all the bullets of the Red Falcon and Berserk Eagle. The Mutant White Lion King was finally within a few dozen meters.

He stopped retreating and rushed forward.

"Switch to combat mode!" Han Xiao yelled.

The bonfire reactor on his back lit up and buzzed. Electricity was transmitted through the bioelectric wires. The muscles of the mecha suddenly expanded, and more power burst out.

As he clenched his fist, he could feel the tyrannical power in the mecha. The additional attributes of the mecha almost doubled his Strength and Dexterity.

Yang Dian and Ned saw from afar that Han Xiao was about to clash head-on with the White Lion King. They were shocked and quickly shouted, "Dodge! Don't engage in close combat with him!"

This mysterious man in the mecha was here to save them. He was their hope. The scene of Yang Dian being crushed was still fresh in their minds. This mysterious man was very likely to repeat the same mistake.

Such a small human actually chose to clash head-on with such a huge beast. It was like hitting a rock with an egg!

The collision between a human and a lion would definitely result in a crushing scene. The two could not bear to see this scene.

However, the mysterious man was not sent flying as they expected. Instead, the White Lion King roared in pain. The huge White Lion King was actually pushed back, and half of Han Xiao's body was buried in the ground. Their strength was actually on par!

Han Xiao's weight was smaller. He channeled his strength into the ground, so he was not sent flying. He exerted force in his legs and suddenly bounced up from the ground. His leg hit the White Lion King's head like a whip, creating a loud bang and creating ripples in the air.

The White Lion King's skull was obviously deformed. Its huge body actually rolled out and landed heavily on the ground.

"Oh my god!"

Yang Dian and Ned were stunned by this scene.

The difference in size between the two was dozens of times. The terrifying White Lion King actually lost to the mysterious man in terms of strength!

Yang Dian's throat was dry. This scene was too shocking. What he could not do did not mean that others could not. He had fought some stronger Martial Artists before, and he felt that none of them were on par with the White Lion King. However, this mysterious man was so strong.

"What kind of mecha is that? I've never heard of it." Yang Dian was shocked.

Ned's eyes widened. "Could it be the secret research of some big organization's laboratory?"

In battle mode, Viper gave Han Xiao 78 points of Strength and 45 points of Dexterity. Han Xiao's Strength and Dexterity attributes were higher than the White Lion King's and comparable to a Martial Artist of the same level. What was more terrifying was that his [Overload] could increase the attributes of Viper!

Han Xiao had noticed Yang Dian and Ned long ago. He did not know what they were, so he did not bother with them.

He controlled the mecha and fought with the mutant White Lion King. Every punch and kick had extremely high Strength damage. The Bonfire Reactor continuously provided energy, and the tall armor blocked the White Lion King's attacks.

It was a waste to use only his fists and kicks. Han Xiao activated the Thermo-Electric Incisor Gauntlets, which had burn damage and left horrifying burns. The Sunworm spewed out flames and ignited the White Lion King's beautiful fur, burning it black. It was a tragic scene.

The man and the lion fought like wild beasts. The ground became bumpy. The two people in the distance felt the tremors like an earthquake and watched this fierce battle in shock. Han Xiao was small and agile, so he had the upper hand. Although the White Lion King's attacks were getting fiercer and fiercer, Han Xiao was able to dodge most of them. Even if he hit the White Lion King, he could not break through the armor of the mecha.

Yang Dian and Ned wanted to help, but they realized that they could not. If they helped recklessly, they might even become a burden. Furthermore, they could not bring themselves to abandon their reinforcements and run away. They could only watch nervously from the side, feeling extremely helpless.

At the same time, the two of them were very surprised by Han Xiao's mecha. They had never heard of any country developing such a powerful single combat equipment.

Blue Star's mecha research had been progressing very slowly. It was rumored that only Theseus had a prototype exoskeleton mecha. However, it was extremely cumbersome and could not increase the user's physical performance. The level of this mysterious mecha was beyond their knowledge!

In a galactic civilization, single combat mechas were the standard equipment of ordinary soldiers. To reduce the gap between them and Supers, mechas were also very cost-effective weapons for the players.
